title: List of races — Canyons Endurance Runs by UTMB 2027
publisher: UTMB World Series / Canyons Endurance Runs by UTMB
claims: The 2027 races page lists the event on 23–26 April 2027 with the 100M and 25K on 23 April, and the 100K and 50K on 24 April.
The 100M and 100K start at China Wall Trailhead, while the 50K and 25K start and finish in Downtown Auburn.
The page shows 4 Running Stones for the 100M, 3 for the 100K, 2 for the 50K and 1 for the 25K.
